import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
import os
import warnings

# Disable progress bars and warnings
pd.set_option("display.max_rows", None)
pd.set_option("display.max_columns", None)
os.environ["PYTHONWARNINGS"] = "ignore"
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Load data from correct paths per Data Overview
train = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Hold-out validation split (80/20, stratified)
train_idx, val_idx = train_test_split(
    train.index, test_size=0.2, stratify=train["author"], random_state=42
)
train_df = train.loc[train_idx]
val_df = train.loc[val_idx]

# Word-level n-grams
word_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=10000, ngram_range=(1, 2), min_df=2, max_df=0.95
)
X_train_word = word_vectorizer.fit_transform(train_df["text"])
X_val_word = word_vectorizer.transform(val_df["text"])
X_test_word = word_vectorizer.transform(test["text"])

# Character-level features (bigrams specifically for style patterns)
char_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char_wb", ngram_range=(2, 4), max_features=50000, min_df=5, max_df=0.90
)
X_train_char = char_vectorizer.fit_transform(train_df["text"])
X_val_char = char_vectorizer.transform(val_df["text"])
X_test_char = char_vectorizer.transform(test["text"])

# Punctuation patterns - capture author-specific punctuation style
punct_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char_wb",
    ngram_range=(1, 3),
    max_features=30000,
    min_df=1,
    max_df=0.95,
    decode_error="replace",
)
X_train_punct = punct_vectorizer.fit_transform(train_df["text"])
X_val_punct = punct_vectorizer.transform(val_df["text"])
X_test_punct = punct_vectorizer.transform(test["text"])


# Explicit linguistic statistics features - capture writing style differences
def extract_text_stats(text):
    tokens = text.split()
    if len(tokens) == 0:
        return 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
    word_count = len(tokens)
    avg_word_len = sum(len(t) for t in tokens) / word_count
    return word_count, avg_word_len, word_count


# Create feature arrays for text statistics
train_stats = []
val_stats = []
test_stats = []

for text in train_df["text"]:
    wc, al, tc = extract_text_stats(text)
    train_stats.append([wc, al, tc])

for text in val_df["text"]:
    wc, al, tc = extract_text_stats(text)
    val_stats.append([wc, al, tc])

for text in test["text"]:
    wc, al, tc = extract_text_stats(text)
    test_stats.append([wc, al, tc])

train_stats = np.array(train_stats)
val_stats = np.array(val_stats)
test_stats = np.array(test_stats)

# Pad text statistics to same shape as sparse matrices for hstack
from scipy.sparse import csc_matrix

X_train_stats = csc_matrix(train_stats)
X_val_stats = csc_matrix(val_stats)
X_test_stats = csc_matrix(test_stats)

# Combine all features
from scipy.sparse import hstack

X_train = hstack([X_train_word, X_train_char, X_train_punct, X_train_stats])
X_val = hstack([X_val_word, X_val_char, X_val_punct, X_val_stats])
X_test = hstack([X_test_word, X_test_char, X_test_punct, X_test_stats])

# Get class order from training data
classes = sorted(train["author"].unique())

# Create proper mapping dictionary for author labels to integers
class_map = {c: i for i, c in enumerate(classes)}
inv_class_map = {i: c for i, c in enumerate(classes)}

# Convert author labels to integers using the mapping
train_labels = train_df["author"].map(class_map)
val_labels = val_df["author"].map(class_map)
print(f"Unique labels in training: {train_labels.nunique()}, classes: {classes}")

# Train Logistic Regression with probability predictions
model = LogisticRegression(
    max_iter=10000, random_state=42, class_weight="balanced", solver="lbfgs", n_jobs=-1
)
model.fit(X_train, train_labels)

# Predict probabilities on validation set
val_proba = model.predict_proba(X_val)

# Create validation submission for metric calculation
val_submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "EAP": val_proba[:, class_map["EAP"]],
        "HPL": val_proba[:, class_map["HPL"]],
        "MWS": val_proba[:, class_map["MWS"]],
    }
)

# Calculate log loss on validation set
y_true = val_labels
y_pred = val_proba

# Calculate and print validation log loss
val_logloss = log_loss(y_true, y_pred)
print(f"Validation Log Loss: {val_logloss:.6f}")

# Generate submission for test set
test_proba = model.predict_proba(X_test)
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": test["id"],
        "EAP": test_proba[:, class_map["EAP"]],
        "HPL": test_proba[:, class_map["HPL"]],
        "MWS": test_proba[:, class_map["MWS"]],
    }
)

# Ensure correct directory structure
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Save submission
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv with {len(submission)} rows")
